name: 79-behavior-comments-and-contract
body:
[79-behavior-comments-and-contract] Described behavior preserved

Desired behavior
Next to non-trivial logic: what users/callers may expect; the change checked against that contract.

Executable contract
1. Before the edit: neighboring comments, requirements, affected implementation read. Described behavior, edge cases, side effects, invariants to keep reconstructed.
2. Change's effect on that contract + next dependent behavior predicted. Comment disagrees with the code → requirements + relevant tests checked; intended behavior established before the fix.
3. Short comment added or refreshed next to non-trivial logic in the same edit when behavior changes. Non-obvious reason explained when known. Trivial logic + line-by-line narration skipped.
4. Real behavior verified per 73, compared with prediction + description. Comment reflects the established contract + limits, is no proof of execution.

Tools and skills
read/grep of source, requirements, relevant tests mandatory for a material discrepancy. edit/write/bash or the matching editor within authorized scope; runtime probe checks the contract. Graph tools desirable for non-trivial callers.

Links: 70-reasoning-poison, 71-user-intent-outcome, 73-tests-not-proof, 81-engineering-invariants.

Anti-patterns
Edit without reading the described contract; comment as proof; invented guarantee/reason; promise rewritten to fit a bug; stale comment after a behavior change; every line narrated.
